name: Ackerstein Group Ltd
summary: Ackerstein Group Ltd operates extensively within the infrastructure, construction, and environmental development sectors. Its core activities include civil engineering and underground infrastructure projects. The company is a key producer, marketer, and seller of diverse concrete products, specifically tailored for landscape design and environmental enhancements. This range encompasses interlocking pavers, various tiles for flooring and cladding, garden and curb stones, stairs, and copings. Furthermore, Ackerstein manufactures mechanized infrastructure components like pipes, along with other general construction materials. The firm also holds interests in the real estate market. Founded in 1925, Ackerstein Group Ltd is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
